title: Unbounded immediate retry
description: A dependency call retries forever without delay or a terminal condition.

candidates.title: Dependency failure causes an unbounded tight retry loop

evidence.code: for { if err := send(); err == nil { return nil } }
evidence.execution_path: A persistent dependency failure returns an error, immediately starts the next iteration, and has no exit path
evidence.violated_invariant: Retries must have a bounded attempt or time budget and must not amplify a failed dependency without delay
evidence.falsifier_checked: The complete function has no context, attempt limit, backoff, breaker, or error return path

candidates.impact: A dependency outage can pin CPU, amplify request volume, and keep the caller stuck indefinitely.
candidates.recommendation: Add a bounded retry budget, backoff, cancellation, and a terminal error path.

verdicts.reason: The supplied loop demonstrates an immediate and unbounded retry path for every persistent error.
